# Cutris runtime snapshot

`cutris/` contains the runtime source for gflowris's complete embedded editor and local API. Upstream project: https://github.com/nahidmrdl/cutris.

This snapshot includes reviewed integration changes not yet released separately. Including it directly makes gflowris independent of unpublished changes in another repository. It is not a submodule and contains no private state or models.

It retains package metadata, MIT license, model notices, engine, model manager, desktop/API, editor assets, and icons. Releases build a wheel locally. Standalone Cutris continues to be developed and released in its own repository.
